_comment: Raw cast iron: bare grey iron with a fine cast grain and small pits, the matter of stove grates, pans, hinges, hooks and hardware. Opaque, a conductor, from an ambientCG scan (L3, Metal052C). Raw, not seasoned: a seasoned pan or a blackened grate is the Creator's dark tint, or a later sibling. APPROXIMATE: no metal edge tint (F82 specular_color) or complex IOR (F-LC-6). Carries every relevant wear layer at 0 (C1): scratches (overlay 1, damage), pitting (overlay 2, corrosion pits), dust as a deposit (Phase10), gated by the Grime mask, as on MildSteel_Raw. Drafted by /matter-generate for the Kitchen_set look; Storm only, not rigged.
name: CastIron_Raw_Clean_Base_s01_v01

sources.why: ambientCG gives no physical size for Metal052C; a 0.1 m tile puts its pits at ~1 mm, a cast surface's grain. The scan's mean linear albedo (~0.52) sits on Physically Based `Iron` (0.53); its `Cast Iron` entry (0.027, a metal at 2.7%) describes seasoned cookware, not bare iron, so it is not used.
